about.description: WTI crude oil perpetual market. The contract tracks West Texas Intermediate crude oil using a futures-based reference price with scheduled contract rolls. Users get linear oil price exposure only, without owning physical crude, inventory claims, or a deliverable futures position, with pricing referencing dated futures and is converted into an implied spot-style oracle with scheduled rolls. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the cash namespace, but are operated by Dreamcash rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
